Specifically got a recording monitor for my camera so I can

1) Record to a hard drive 
2) Have something aside from the tiny camera screen to see what the camera is doing while recording
3) Play with a toy

Got some new toys for video production and excited to play with them

Hoping to solve a few pain points in the ol' WORKFLOW y'know?

*slaps roof of flowchart*

At a restaurant that has a dedicated adults section and actually is enforcing it

I might buy real estate here 

(I cannot afford real estate here)
Hell yeah hit em with the writ large
Also to be clear this is by no means me implying that Bluesky fits that description either

Seeing the replies on twitter being a bunch of people in a huff about how twitter is “where the real conversations are held” is really something

> How dare they leave this one dude’s website! I have a vested interest in it!

Okay HERE is the video with the updates n such

Short version: Stuff Keeps Happening is moving from Mondays to Thursdays.

Long version: www.youtube.com/watch?v=epdR...

This is *not* the video about my content updates and stuff but it *is* a video that is now hosted on the internet for your viewing pleasure

The latest installment of my Satisfactory let's play. No game experience (or life experience) required.

www.youtube.com/watch?v=HUma...

Putting together a video for today that'll have a few small announcements about my content schedule and some other plans for the year

Nothings going away, just moving stuff around so my schedule can be less awful
In an alternate timeline somewhere out there...
I put her in outer space so she can breathe
I’m something of an artist myself
You can be absolutely certain I have already taken the new earth photo NASA shared and have put anime eyes on it and used it as clip art in an upcoming video
Unifying the world just not how he had hoped
Masterful play sir; I did not realize you had negative game

My news app just refreshed when I opened it and the headline went from 

"Trump claims Iran could be 'obliterated' in one night"

to

"Trump agrees to two week cease-fire if strait is opened"
